issue: A body closing token inside a quoted value or comment discards valid captions
scope: Four authored failing legacy P-clock inputs (quoted attribute,comment,Title raw text,Style raw text) and two healthy controls share independent1..2s SRT and five-frame raw Y4M. All four failures also reproduce before Sync support,so this is pre-existing. The candidate remains prototype-only and adds no accepted ID.
cause: sami_tags uses an unqualified folded.find("</body") before scanning whole tags/comments.
prototype_note: Prototype was based on the post-Sync parser before the pending BR/.sami fixes. Apply only body-boundary logic later; never replace production with this full snapshot.
